links_packages: {links} links in {packages} packages added to the LinkGrabber
nzb_one: NZB added to the LinkGrabber, 1 file
nzb_many: NZB added to the LinkGrabber, {files} files
link_service_example: The address you open rDownloader at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8710
link_token_hint: From Settings > Clients & API > Desktop in rDownloader
link_insecure: Connect unencrypted – only advisable in your own network
link_insecure_why: Over http the token travels in the clear; anyone on the network between can read it.
link_failed: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
link_invalid_address: Enter the full address with http:// or https://, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8710.
link_insecure_unconfirmed: This address is not encrypted. Tick “Connect unencrypted” to use it anyway.
link_unreachable: rDownloader could not be reached at this address. Check the address and that the server is running.
link_not_rdownloader: The program at this address is not rDownloader. The token was not sent to it.
link_token_rejected: The token was not accepted. Create a new one in rDownloader under Settings > Clients & API > Desktop.
link_missing_scope: The token lacks the rights the capture agent needs. Create a token under Settings > Clients & API > Desktop.
link_not_stored: The server accepted the token, but the agent could not save it. Its log says why.
